List the datasets in the database

Source: R/catalog.R
list_datasets.Rd

timepoints gives the rating phases a dataset holds. All but two datasets have a single phase; see get_dataset().

Usage

list_datasets(version = "latest")

Arguments

version

Release version, or "latest".

Value

A tibble with one row per dataset.

Examples

# \donttest{
list_datasets()
#> # A tibble: 59 × 12
#>    dataset_code      first_author  year study_name  n_subjects n_items n_ratings
